{
  "participants": [
    {
      "login": "jeanpablojp",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Approach ACK with ~4x speedup benchmark; raised concerns on next_index drift and mapWallet clear order"
    },
    {
      "login": "frankomosh",
      "stance": "objection",
      "note": "Tested ACK (previously Concept ACK); raised concern on leak check timing and suggested additional assertions in spend harness"
    },
    {
      "login": "sedited",
      "stance": "neutral",
      "note": "asked whether the author intends to take frankomosh's suggestion nits"
    }
  ],
  "claims": [
    {
      "id": "rc:3887572966",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "descriptor next_index drift causes successive iterations to derive different change addresses and invalidates drift assertion comment assumptions",
      "quote": "The descriptor's `next_index` isn't reset here, so the same input builds a different transaction depending on how many ran before it.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "addressed by force-push",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3950606623",
        "c:5572034837"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5572034837",
      "status_by_quote": "Force-pushed addressing https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36068#discussion_r3887572966"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3887572967",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "clearing mapWallet before wtxOrdered and m_txos leaves latent dangling references",
      "quote": "mapWallet.clear() runs before wtxOrdered and m_txos, and both point into it. Nothing dereferences in between so it's latent",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author gave rationale and reviewer did not push back",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3950611354"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3950611354",
      "status_by_quote": "No reason, will leave as is but can think about it in case I have to touch it again. Thanks."
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4070883464",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "checking state at the start of an input causes leaks to be reported on the subsequent input, which does not reproduce in isolation",
      "quote": "when one input leaks, the crash is reported on the next input, which then does not reproduce on its own",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "addressed by force-push",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4074975584",
        "c:5781745414"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "c:5781745414",
      "status_by_quote": "Force-pushed addressing https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36068#discussion_r4070883464"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4096035917",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "assert inserted output counts in the fuzzed wallet to catch future regressions",
      "quote": "Asserting inserted output counts here would help catch any future regression in this harness",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author deferred to a follow-up PR",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4316065579"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4316065579",
      "status_by_quote": "This is a good one, but I'll leave this for a follow-up PR"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4096132028",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "assert that CreateTransaction result fee is non-negative",
      "quote": "Also, I think we could do an assert check on the result here ?..had also suggested this elswhere",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author deferred to a follow-up PR",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4316067349"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4316067349",
      "status_by_quote": "Same: https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36068#discussion_r4316065579"
    }
  ],
  "support": [
    {
      "id": "r:5059090941",
      "verdict": "Approach ACK",
      "reason": "Ran the qa-assets corpus on master and on this head, the speedup reproduces, around 4x here.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "tested",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5277098956",
      "verdict": "Concept ACK",
      "reason": "improving performance",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "none",
      "areas": []
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5307320649",
      "verdict": "Tested ACK",
      "reason": "This improves performance of this harness.",
      "substantive": true,
      "evidence": "tested",
      "areas": []
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Author replied to frankomosh's remaining assertion suggestions, deferring them to a follow-up PR as confirmed in response to sedited. All claims are now answered or fixed.",
  "waiting_on": [
    {
      "on": "nothing",
      "what": "all suggestions and objections have been answered or fixed, and ACKs are in place",
      "id": ""
    }
  ]
}
